protocol.coordinate_convention: signed_displacement/update_l2/q0 use raw saved displacement; evaluated_update_l2 measures separately cast endpoints
protocol.endpoint_convention: Fractions 0 and 1 copy exact saved endpoints into model dtypes; interior points interpolate raw saved values. Arithmetic endpoint-cast roundoff is recorded separately.
protocol.evaluation_map: Every raw point is cast into the evaluation parameter dtypes before CE. This map can be piecewise constant, so distinct raw updates can evaluate identically.
protocol.interpretation: Only interpolation endpoints are saved optimizer states; q0 is condition-specific. Sampled barriers are not continuous-path or global barriers.
protocol.precision: Raw mixed-dtype saved anchors; FP32 interpolation/directions; copy into actual model evaluation dtypes, matching surfaces; chunked FP64 norms; eager attention

1.training_ce_note: Recorded CE uses the trainer's mixed parameter dtypes and training mode; this analysis evaluates cast saved endpoints in eval mode. Signed differences are diagnostic, not equality assertions.

first_update_plane.q0_definition: FP32 normalized raw saved first optimizer update; condition-specific; evaluations cast model parameters
first_update_plane.q1_definition: Shared random row 0 projected orthogonally to q0 and normalized
first_update_plane.endpoint_comparison_convention: Normalized FP32 raw-axis reconstruction cast into model evaluation dtypes, versus separately loaded saved endpoint cast into those same dtypes. Casting-boundary roundoff is measured, not silently replaced.

memory_note: At most one raw mixed BF16/FP32 anchor, one FP32 update, and one FP32 random row; no global FP64 weights or second random row on GPU.
